canonical_claim.template: FHA Single Family Loan Performance Trends (Credit Risk Report) (Aug 2026 report) reports 90-day delinquency rate, month of August 2026: {value} percent, Aug 2026.

required_qualifiers.source: FHA Single Family Loan Performance Trends (Credit Risk Report), Aug 2026 report, Table 1. Delinquency Rates by Month (non-seasonally adjusted block)
required_qualifiers.exclusions: FHA-insured single-family forward mortgages in active insurance at month end; rates are not seasonally adjusted (the report also prints a seasonally adjusted block, which is not restated here)
required_qualifiers.nature: official figure restated as printed; not computed or adjusted by FinanceRateCalc

does_not_establish: the delinquency risk of any one borrower or loan
a foreclosure completion or loss rate
that the figure has not been revised in a later edition (check the latest report)
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
